defective.instructions: Is this hazelnut defective? The image shows a hazelnut in its shell.

criteria.true: yes, the hazelnut has a visible defect: a crack in the shell, a cut mark on the shell, a hole in the shell, printed marks or ink on the shell
criteria.false: no, the hazelnut is intact and defect-free

defect_type.instructions: What kind of defect does this hazelnut have?

criteria.cut: a cut mark on the shell
criteria.print: printed marks or ink on the shell
